steps.message: The build succeeds. Let me clean up the test harness and review the final patch:

## Diagnosis Hacker News' API returns comment bodies as HTML in which long auto-linked URLs have their **visible text** truncated with an ellipsis, while the `href` keeps the complete URL: ```html https://example.com/a/very/lon... ``` `DialogUtils.showTextSelectionDialog()` passed `comment.text` straight to `HtmlTextView.setHtml()`, so the select-text dialog rendered that same shortened text. Selecting and copying therefore produced a broken, incomplete link — exactly the reported bug. Truncation in the normal comment list is intentional (it keeps rows compact), so the fix belongs only on the select-text path. ## Fix **`utils/Utils.java`** — added `expandTruncatedLinks(String html)`, which walks every `` tag and replaces the link text with the full `href` when that text has been truncated: - The href is reinserted **still HTML-escaped**, so entities like `/` and `&` decode identically to before and the displayed URL is correct. - It only expands when the visible text (after entity decoding) is genuinely the *beginning* of the href — compared with the scheme stripped from both. This guards against mangling an anchor whose real title just happens to end in `...`. - Handles both `...` and the single-character `…`, plus null/empty input and comments with no links. **`utils/DialogUtils.java`** — the dialog now calls `htmlTextView.setHtml(Utils.expandTruncatedLinks(text))`. ## Verification I validated the transformation logic against realistic HN markup in a standalone harness before building: | Case | Result | |---|---| | Truncated URL with escaped `/` slashes | expanded to full URL ✅ | | Truncated URL with `&` query params | expanded, entities intact ✅ | | Short, untruncated link | unchanged ✅ | | Anchor with real title ending `...` | unchanged ✅ | | Multiple links / multiline HTML | each handled independently ✅ | | Plain text containing `...`, empty, null | unchanged ✅ | `./gradlew clean assembleDebug` → **BUILD SUCCESSFUL**. Links now appear in full in the select-text view, so a selection includes the whole URL, while link tapping (`OnClickATagListener` → `href`) and comment-list rendering are unaffected.
